day: # The Church of England's Common Worship Lectionary for Sundays, Principal
# Feasts and Holy Days, and Festivals, as the Church of England website
# gives it ("Lectionary", Common Worship main volume, current with its
# corrections; saved October 2026), with two of the 2005 corrections
# (GS 1520A, listed in the Weekday Lectionary booklet, pp. 50-51) that the
# web page lacks: Proper 8 Year B reads Lamentations 3:22-33, and the Third
# Service of Ascension Day has Psalms 110, 150.  Years A, B and C, Year A
# beginning with Advent 2025 (the website's table of lectionary years).
# For the Common Worship calendar (data/Anglican, variant common-worship):
# tradition.csv names it with `readings,cofe-cw cofe-cw-weekday`.  Every day is a date rule:
#   Principal Service: kinds ot, psalm, epistle, gospel (the first and
#     second readings; in Eastertide the first is often Acts).  On the
#     Sundays after Trinity the Continuous Old Testament and psalm are
#     ot_s/psalm_s and the Related ones ot_c/psalm_c.
#   Second Service and Third Service: sets of their own titles; psalm, then
#     ot (Old Testament and Apocrypha), nt (Acts to Revelation) and gospel
#     by book; the "Gospel at Holy Communion" of a Second Service is its
#     gospel.  On Principal Feasts and Festivals the psalms printed for
#     morning or evening are psalm_morning and psalm_evening.
#   Festivals and Principal Feasts in feasts.csv are keyed by their ids
#     (cw_...), so their readings go with them when the Rules move them
#     with "<name>: Second Service" etc.; the Evening Prayer on the Eve is
#     the day before (offset -1).  The Sundays the Rules allow for the
#     Epiphany and Candlemas, and the Monday the Baptism then moves to, are
#     titled sets marked "(observed)".  Christmas Day has Sets I, II, III.
#   The Sundays of Epiphany are counted from the Baptism (the Sunday after
#     6 January); the Fourth's provision may fall on 3 February; Propers
#     1-3 are the Sundays 4-10, 11-17 and 18-24 February before the Second
#     Sunday before Lent, which is kept only after 2 February; Propers 3-25
#     after Trinity Sunday are the Sundays between their dates; Bible Sunday
#     (the Last Sunday after Trinity) and All Saints' Sunday are titled sets;
#     the Sundays before Advent count back from Advent Sunday.
# Citations: chapter:verse, en dashes, optional verses and psalms in
# parentheses ([ ] in the source), alternatives joined with " or " (each
# with its book), the asterisk marking a psalm with a shorter alternative
# dropped (those alternatives are not given here), canticles as
# The Easter Vigil is listed on Easter Eve.  Not given: the Dedication
# Festival (no fixed day), the lesser festivals and commons (published
